named-native-query.name: EsqSubtreeRow.subtreeFromOrg
named-native-query.query: WITH org_subtree (pk, kind, name, d, parent_pk, path_str, lvl) AS ( SELECT o.org_pk, o.org_et_pk, o.org_name, o.org_desc, o.org_org_pk, p.ep_path, 1 FROM esq_org o JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = o.org_pk WHERE o.org_pk = TO_NUMBER(:seedId) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' UNION ALL SELECT o.org_pk, o.org_et_pk, o.org_name, o.org_desc, o.org_org_pk, p.ep_path, t.lvl + 1 FROM esq_org o JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = o.org_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON o.org_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ) SELECT TO_CHAR(pk) AS id , pk AS entity_id , kind AS kind , name AS name , d AS "desc" , TO_CHAR(parent_pk) AS parent_id , lvl AS lvl , path_str AS entity_path FROM org_subtree UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(u.usr_pk), u.usr_pk, u.usr_et_pk, u.usr_name, u.usr_desc, TO_CHAR(u.usr_org_pk), t.lvl + 1, p.ep_path FROM esq_user u JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = u.usr_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON u.usr_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' AND u.usr_deleted_flg = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(a.acc_pk), a.acc_pk, a.acc_et_pk, a.acc_id, a.acc_desc, TO_CHAR(a.acc_usr_pk), t.lvl + 2, p.ep_path FROM esq_account a JOIN esq_user u ON a.acc_usr_pk = u.usr_pk JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = a.acc_pk JOIN org_subtree t ON u.usr_org_pk = t.pk WHERE p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ORDER BY 7 DESC, 6 NULLS LAST

named-native-query.name: EsqSubtreeRow.subtreeFromUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT TO_CHAR(u.usr_pk) AS id , u.usr_pk AS entity_id , u.usr_et_pk AS kind , u.usr_name AS name , u.usr_desc AS "desc" , TO_CHAR(u.usr_org_pk) AS parent_id , 1 AS lvl , p.ep_path AS entity_path FROM esq_user u JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = u.usr_pk WHERE u.usr_pk = TO_NUMBER(:seedId) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(a.acc_pk), a.acc_pk, a.acc_et_pk, a.acc_id, a.acc_desc, TO_CHAR(a.acc_usr_pk), 2, p.ep_path FROM esq_account a JOIN esq_entity_path p ON p.ep_pk = a.acc_pk WHERE a.acc_usr_pk = TO_NUMBER(:seedId) AND p.ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' ORDER BY 7 DESC, 6 NULLS LAST
